summary: On August 5, 2026, Alto Ingredients, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into an At-The-Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Craig-Hallum Capital Group, The Benchmark Company, and H.C. Wainwright. The company may sell up to $50.0 million of common stock under its effective shelf registration statement. Agents receive a 3.0% commission. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation, so no deal terms are applicable.
